mainEntity.name: How often should I reconcile my accounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly, every account, without exception. If you go longer, errors compound and get harder to trace.

mainEntity.name: What's the single most important bookkeeping habit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reconciliation. It's the one habit that keeps every other number honest.

mainEntity.name: Do I really need separate business bank accounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Commingling personal and business funds is the root cause of most of the messes I get called in to fix.

mainEntity.name: Is bad bookkeeping actually expensive, or just annoying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expensive. Missed deductions, overpaid taxes, penalties on payroll and sales tax, and bigger CPA bills at year-end all trace back to sloppy books.
